scope:
Audit squared slopes of separate strings against the accepted common coupling.

Screen every key at two velocities, compare the previously known references,
check long holds, measure native cost, then render two complete MIDI pieces.
Parallel screening timings are not performance measurements.
status: Separate-string stretch candidate; listening comparison pending
baseline: User-accepted common coupling (7d7546e5), acceptance recorded in 412e84c5
physical_change: Sum squared modal slopes separately across strings and polarisations for the existing scalar tension glide; omit nonphysical cross-string products and onset bloom

summary.note: Changes in all 88 keys are screened. Only the twelve known reference pairs have a reference comparison; not blind validation.

timing.scope: 14-second native script; three sequential runs each, alternating order, includes raw I/O

limitations: The shared aggregate tension glide remains an approximation, not independent SI tension dynamics per string or proof of perceptual improvement. No manual note-specific retuning. Known references cover twelve cases, not the entire keyboard.
